name: gmrunner
subtitle: GameMaker Studio 1.4 runner for iOS
description: Personal AltStore source for gmrunner, a clean-room GameMaker Studio 1.4 runner. The app contains no game data: it loads a data.win you copy in yourself.

apps.name: gmrunner
apps.subtitle: GameMaker Studio 1.4 runner
apps.localizedDescription:
Runs a GameMaker Studio 1.4 game from your own data.win. After installing, open the app once, then copy data.win and the game's .ogg files into On My iPhone > gmrunner with the Files app.

This build is an early milestone: a status screen and an asset viewer. Games do not run yet.

versions.localizedDescription: First build: status screen with input test, data.win loader and asset viewer.
